levels.name: ND 1: National Diploma Year 1
levels.description: Foundation nursing arts, human anatomy, physiology, and pre-clinical skills

levels.name: ND 2: National Diploma Year 2
levels.description: Basic pharmacology, community health, medical-surgical nursing foundations

levels.name: HND: Higher National Diploma / Year 3-4
levels.description: Advanced medical-surgical nursing, maternal-child health, nursing administration

levels.name: Year 1: Basic Nursing & Pre-Clinical
levels.description: Anatomy, Physiology, Fundamentals of Nursing, Microbiology, Nutrition

levels.name: Year 2: Intermediate & Pharmacology
levels.description: Pharmacology, Medical-Surgical I, Pathophysiology, Clinical Assessment

levels.name: Year 3: Med-Surg & Specialized Care
levels.description: Advanced Med-Surg, Critical Care, Psychiatric Nursing, Pediatrics

levels.name: Final Year: Midwifery & Public Health
levels.description: Maternal & Child Health, Community Health, Management & Ethics

levels.name: RN Licensure / NCLEX Examination Prep
levels.description: Comprehensive Board Prep, CBT Mock Drills, High-Yield Question Banks

subjects.name: Anatomy
subjects.description: Human gross and microscopic anatomy, structural organization of organ systems, directional terminology, and anatomical foundations for nursing practice.

subjects.name: Physiology
subjects.description: Functional mechanisms of human organ systems, homeostatic regulatory pathways, cellular physiology, and physiological adaptation in health and illness.

subjects.name: Foundation of Nursing Science
subjects.description: Core nursing philosophy, nursing process, principles of asepsis, patient hygiene, therapeutic communication, vital sign assessment, and foundational clinical nursing skills.

subjects.name: Psychology
subjects.description: Foundational behavioral science, developmental stages across the lifespan, emotional and cognitive processes, stress responses, and patient-nurse interpersonal dynamics.

subjects.name: Primary Health Care
subjects.description: Community health strategies, preventive medicine, immunization protocols, sanitation, maternal-child health services, and essential healthcare delivery systems.

subjects.name: French
subjects.description: Basic French communication, grammatical fundamentals, essential healthcare terminology, and introductory conversational skills for bilingual patient care.

subjects.name: Philosophy of Science
subjects.description: Scientific inquiry, epistemological foundations, the scientific method, paradigm shifts, empirical evidence, and the philosophy underpinning biomedical science.

subjects.name: Entrepreneurship
subjects.description: Fundamentals of entrepreneurship, innovation in healthcare delivery, business management, financial literacy, and career independence for nurses.

subjects.name: Philosophy and Logic
subjects.description: Principles of critical thinking, deductive and inductive reasoning, identification of logical fallacies, argumentative rigor, and rational clinical decision-making.

subjects.name: Pharmacology
subjects.description: Introduction to basic pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics, drug administration routes, dosage calculation fundamentals, and medication safety principles.

subjects.name: Food and Nutrition
subjects.description: Essential nutrients, dietary guidelines, metabolism, nutritional assessment, deficiency disorders, and therapeutic diets in patient recovery.

announcements.title: Welcome to the ND 1 Nursing Curriculum
announcements.content: The academic structure for National Diploma 1 (ND 1) has been updated with 11 core nursing subjects. Study notes and CBT question banks will be published by the administration.
